title: 2021–2022 Football Player Goal Contributions by Position and Age
text: This scatterplot displays 2,703 outfield players across the 2021–2022 European Big 5 Leagues season, comparing total season goal contributions (Goals + Assists) across player age and position. Hover over any point to see the player’s name, squad, age, goals, assists, and per-90 efficiency.

title: About
text: This project analyzes 2,703 outfield football players from the 2021–2022 European Big 5 Leagues season, examining how season goal contributions (Goals + Assists) and per-90 efficiency vary by position and player age.
